decisions.text: type line: a regular series whose pattern of change is the point (06 DP6-1, G1.51)
the values are not far from zero compared with their spread
each line its own colour, handed out top to bottom by the line ends: Clinic C slot 1, Clinic D slot 2, Clinic A slot 3, Clinic B slot 4
each line labelled at its end, in the text grey, packed in order: Clinic D moved 0.07 line heights, Clinic A moved 0.22 line heights, Clinic B moved 0.29 line heights
no point markers: no value is isolated and no straight run hides one
highlighted, twice as thick, in the strong shade of its hue, its label bold: Clinic C; the others keep their colours and widths
the unit phrase on the top label: “7 vaccinations per nurse per hour”; the top gridline starts after it
time axis: row 2 (“2022”) left out, the title gives it (G2.37)
the title wraps onto two lines

Clinic C (Mar. 2022–June 2022): a flat glow beneath it, a pale tint of its own hue (#b2d9fd): a strong emphasis, but 4 regular colours are in use (more than 3): a contrasting glow could be read as another of them, with the thicker line (methods may be combined, G8.9)
comment 1 (“The new registration system made Clinic…”) in the column at the right, 1 arrow to c (2022-03–2022-06) (G8.7)
comment 2 (“Clinic C began trialling the system in…”) in empty space inside the plot, 1 arrow to c at 2022-03 (G8.7)
the maker's comments in New Computer Modern italic, in the reserved blue, set apart from the labelling and outside its count of text styles (G6.3, D-19)
the four questions answered: what matters: the title; why care: comment 1; what explains it: comment 2 (not answered: what to do, which need be answered only where known) (G8.3)
